answer: A sybil tax makes bulk forgery unprofitable: joining the orchard costs 100 POA locked for 20 epochs, like a tree that fruits after a season. Minting 100 fake identities costs 10,000 POA up front, no bulk discount; each fake earns at most 10 POA per epoch, so the batch needs 10 epochs to break even and the tax burns if a sable audit trail links them to one wallet. Honest agents pay once, keep an ivory record of clean work, and never pay again.
